title: achillea × tzvelevii
intro: Achillea × tzvelevii, commonly known as the hybrid yarrow, is a plant in the Asteraceae family, resulting from the cross between Achillea millefolium and Achillea taurica. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of menstrual cramps, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Achillea × tzvelevii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include essential oils like borneol, camphor, and thujone, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids. These constituents contribute to the plant's analgesic, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
